text: それで　いわが　バリバリ　くだけるんじゃヨ

structure.jp: いわが　バリバリ　くだけるんじゃヨ
structure.en: rocks crumble apart with a crunch, you see

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing shows it is the tool used: 'with' or 'using'. それで = 'with that'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んじゃ is the old-man form of んだ (のだ), which gives the feel of explaining something. くだけるんじゃ = 'they break apart, you see'.
